item.title: Chapter 288: Anthos
item.description: Anthos burned on purpose, and it was the most beautiful thing he had ever seen, and he understood at once why nobody who lived there had ever wanted to stop.

item.description: They argued about the name for nine days, and then Xiaoyu settled it by accident.

item.title: Chapter 271: Light the Lamp
item.description: The stone was too hot to touch, and he touched it anyway.
